TICKETS: I paid around £32 through GetYourGuide for my ticket. GetYourGuide is a platform where you can discover and book experiences and activities. BEST TIME TO GO: I’d recommend going outside school holidays if you can. If you have to go during the holidays, get there for opening and head straight to the rides you really want to do. I also included the time when I went there and would recommend to go at similar times as it got more lively every minute (I went in September). #rome #visitrome #romeitaly #trevi #europetravel more 125K 340 73.5K 24.7K Sinah - Travel Creator · 8-26 The underrated Christmas markets you need to visit 🎄👇🏼✨FOLLOW @‌sinahsstories for more travel inspo, guides & itineraries like this!Everyone knows Strasbourg as the ultimate Christmas city, but it’s often packed and can feel a bit overwhelming. If you’re craving that cosy festive feeling without the extreme crowds, these smaller, underrated markets in southern Germany are such a good alternative.✨ RavensburgThis Christmas market wraps around the medieval towers and half-timbered houses. Stalls usually open from late November to just before Christmas, and everything is walkable in the old town: perfect for an afternoon of wandering, mulled wine and regional snacks.✨ Lindau (Bodensee)Lindau’s Hafenweihnacht sits right at the harbour on Lake Constance, with views of the water and the lighthouse. The market typically runs from late November through December weekends, and it’s especially beautiful in the evening when the boats and stalls are all lit up. Dress warm, the lake breeze is romantic but chilly.✨ KemptenKempten’s market is a classic Allgäu Christmas vibe, set between historic buildings and cosy side streets. It usually runs daily in Advent, with plenty of local cheese, sausages and handmade crafts. It’s easy to combine with a day trip into the nearby mountains if you want snow and alpine views as well.✨ Munich – Residenz Christmas VillageIn the inner courtyard of the Residenz you’ll find one of Munich’s most atmospheric, slightly hidden markets. It typically runs from late November until Christmas Eve, with wooden huts, a small “village” layout and a more intimate feeling than the big Marienplatz market. It’s right in the center, so you can easily visit in the evening after sightseeing or shopping.✨ Hi, I’m Sinah and I love sharing travel tips that are actually useful: the little underrated spots, easy ways to see a place, and the kind of things that make a trip feel magical, plus guides and itineraries that help you explore the places. fullText: TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok Mr. Afterparty · 9-6 After Part 1, the comments made one thing very clear: this movement goes much further than a handful of famous clubs.From Amsterdam to Athens, Copenhagen, Berlin, Warsaw, Prague and beyond, more dancefloors are choosing to limit photography, filming or phone use altogether.The rules are not identical everywhere. Some clubs ban photos and videos. Others ask people to keep their phones away from the dancefloor completely. But the idea behind them is similar: protect privacy, protect the atmosphere and give people space to experience the night without constantly being documented.Club culture existed long before every moment could be recorded and uploaded instantly. 🤔 השאלה היא לא רק איך הלשון נראית, אלא איך היא עובדת. כפי שניתן לראות בתמונה 📸, כשהלשון קשורה היא לא מצליחה להתרומם ולהיצמד לחיך. התוצאה היא “תפיסה שטחית” שגורמת לתינוק להתעייף מהר 😴, לבלוע אוויר 🌬️ ולפעמים גם לסבול מגזים או מחוסר שקט 😣. איך תבדקו את זה כבר בבית החולים? 🏨 אל תחכו שמשהו ישתבש, פשוט תבדקו 👇 1️⃣ הכנה: שטפו ידיים היטב 🧼 2️⃣ הבדיקה: הכניסו בעדינות שתי אצבעות מתחת ללשון של התינוק ונסו להרים אותה מעט כלפי מעלה 👆 3️⃣ מה מחפשים? 🔍 אנחנו רוצים לראות שהלשון עולה בחופשיות. אם אתם מרגישים התנגדות, או רואים שהקצה של הלשון נמשך פנימה לצורת “לב” ❤️ – ייתכן שהלשון קשורה. אמהות מניקות? Parliament, the Chain Bridge, Buda Castle and the riverside promenades all take on a different character as the days get shorter and the sun sits lower in the sky.🌇 There’s also something particularly enjoyable about exploring Budapest on foot at this time of year. You can move from colourful streets and leafy parks to grand boulevards, historic cafés and riverside viewpoints within the same afternoon. And when the sun starts setting earlier, the city lights come on while there’s still plenty of colour left in the sky. 🤔 השאלה היא לא רק איך הלשון נראית, אלא איך היא עובדת. כפי שניתן לראות בתמונה 📸, כשהלשון קשורה היא לא מצליחה להתרומם ולהיצמד לחיך. התוצאה היא “תפיסה שטחית” שגורמת לתינוק להתעייף מהר 😴, לבלוע אוויר 🌬️ ולפעמים גם לסבול מגזים או מחוסר שקט 😣. איך תבדקו את זה כבר בבית החולים? 🏨 אל תחכו שמשהו ישתבש, פשוט תבדקו 👇 1️⃣ הכנה: שטפו ידיים היטב 🧼 2️⃣ הבדיקה: הכניסו בעדינות שתי אצבעות מתחת ללשון של התינוק ונסו להרים אותה מעט כלפי מעלה 👆 3️⃣ מה מחפשים? 🔍 אנחנו רוצים לראות שהלשון עולה בחופשיות. אם אתם מרגישים התנגדות, או רואים שהקצה של הלשון נמשך פנימה לצורת “לב” ❤️ – ייתכן שהלשון קשורה. אמהות מניקות? 🤱 שימו לב אם יש לכן פצעים או כאבים חזקים בזמן ההנקה 😖 – זה סימן אזהרה קלאסי לכך שהלשון לא מבצעת את פעולת ה”גריפה” בצורה נכונה. אבחון מוקדם יכול למנוע הרבה תסכול בהמשך הדרך 🙏 מוזמנות לשואל כל ש⁩אלה על לשון קשורה⬇️ #לשוןקשורה#ייעוץהנקה Xenia_babysleep 2460 · 4d ago כשעידו טאקו הוא בועז הגדול, ברור שאנחנו נמצמץ… #עצמאות #בקולנוע מה הסרט 4845 · 9-7 חלק 2? TICKETS: I paid around £32 through GetYourGuide for my ticket. GetYourGuide is a platform where you can discover and book experiences and activities. BEST TIME TO GO: I’d recommend going outside school holidays if you can. If you have to go during the holidays, get there for opening and head straight to the rides you really want to do. Save this for your Prague trip 📌 📍 Hoxton Burgers #prague #praguefood #praguefoodtips #pragueburger #vinohrady Time For Prague 253 · 1d ago Why St. John of Nepomuk is the statue that millions touch on Charles Bridge in Prague 👇 Legend says in 1393 King Wenceslaus IV of Bohemia suspected his queen was unfaithful and demanded the priest reveal her confession 💔🤐 John refused The king had him tortured and thrown off Charles Bridge into the Vltava River Weeks later his body was found downstream, and legend says five glowing stars appeared above the water where he fell ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Historians today think the real reason was political, a power struggle between the king and the Archbishop of Prague, and the confession story was not even written down until decades later John was made a saint in 1729 😇 You will find dozens of statues of him across Prague, thousands across the Czech Republic, and tens of thousands of statues and churches around the world. In Germany 🇩🇪, an entire church in Munich called the Asamkirche was built just for him, and his following also spread through Spanish Catholic colonizers to countries like the Philippines, Mexico, Cuba, Colombia, and Paraguay, where sometimes even full towns are named after him. 🇪🇸🌍 His tomb sits in St. Vitus Cathedral at Prague Castle 🇨🇿 Legend still says touching the plaque beneath his statue on Charles Bridge grants a wish within a year 🍀 Truly one of Prague's most famous and also greatest stories and legends #PragueHistory #CharlesBridge #StJohnOfNepomuk Time For Prague 1116 · 9-22 Send this reel to someone you’d love to visit Prague at Christmas with! 🎄✨💌 Dates: November 28 2026 - January 6 2027 📌 Save this for your European winter trip Time For Prague 16.2K · 9-2 Prague has a food problem, and most tourists never realize it until it's too late 🤮 😨 🇨🇿 Prague actually has more restaurants and cafes per square metre than Manhattan, which sounds great, but it means it's incredibly easy to end up in a tourist trap instead of a real local meal As a Prague local, I mapped 400+ of my favourite places across the city, restaurants, cafes, bars, and hidden gems most tourists never find This is everything you need for the ultimate Prague food guide and cit

caption: as south africans we always feel like international travel is too expensive because of the weak rand… but hear me out. there are actually countries where our rand goes surprisingly far like, eating out for under R150 pp. and i put them all in this carousel so you can start planning 😌✈️ we’re talking thailand, turkey, india, vietnam, hungary and
fullText: TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok Caitlin Reece ✨ · 5-18 as south africans we always feel like international travel is too expensive because of the weak rand… but hear me out. there are actually countries where our rand goes surprisingly far like, eating out for under R150 pp. and i put them all in this carousel so you can start planning 😌✈️ we’re talking thailand, turkey, india, vietnam, hungary and more. destinations where the exchange rate actually works in our favour and you can have an incredible holiday. think delicious food , beautiful coastlines, rich history, and experiences that would cost you more back home. 🏝️ 🥘 🖼️ this isn’t about being ‘broke travelling’ either. it’s just being smart about where your money has the most power. R2000 in vietnam hits different to R2000 in italy, you know?i did the research so you don’t have to. swipe through for the full list and save this for your next trip planning session 🗺️drop your dream destination in the comments 👇🏽 and tell me, have you been to any of these countries I’ve listed?? 🌎 ‼️disclaimer ‼️Some people missed the point of this post. I did not state that these are the CHEAPEST destinations for South African travellers. Unfortunately, the rand itself is weak and travelling in general is expensive, even to a third world country because flights are priced on duration and distance so you’ll pay a lot based on where our country is geographically. However, this post is for travellers who want a more affordable holiday compared to places where the rand is very weak, like European countries. In countries using the euro, pound or dollar, your rands won’t go far and food will be very expensive! For example, R20k is about 900 pounds which goes quickly but R20k can give you 115k rupees and with a lower cost of living in india, your money will go MUCH further! However, these first world countries have excellent public transport so transport is cheaper (using the bus and metro) even high speed trains are generally cheaper than flights. A 3 star hotel in those countries would be suitable but you might opt for 5 star in India for example, then your accommodation would be more. Everything is relative and comes down to the kind of traveller you are. But if you’re planning to travel for the first time, these could definitely be more affordable options for you! #southafricantravel #budgettravel #affordabletravel #wheretovisit #holiday [creatorsearch insights, where to travel, affordable travel destinations to visit as south africans] more 80.9K 586 48K 13.4K Comments You may like Log in What would you like to watch on TikTok? 🦦 Animals 😆 Comedy 🏞️ Travel 🍔 Food ⚽ Sports 💄 Beauty & Style 🎨 Art 🕹️ Gaming 💯 Science & Education 💃 Dance ✂️ DIY 🚗 Auto 🎹 Music 💡 Life Hacks 💕 Oddly Satisfying 🥾 Outdoors 💖 Fandom Continue (0/3) Log in By continuing with an account located in Israel, you agree

🤔 השאלה היא לא רק איך הלשון נראית, אלא איך היא עובדת. כפי שניתן לראות בתמונה 📸, כשהלשון קשורה היא לא מצליחה להתרומם ולהיצמד לחיך. התוצאה היא “תפיסה שטחית” שגורמת לתינוק להתעייף מהר 😴, לבלוע אוויר 🌬️ ולפעמים גם לסבול מגזים או מחוסר שקט 😣. איך תבדקו את זה כבר בבית החולים? 🏨 אל תחכו שמשהו ישתבש, פשוט תבדקו 👇 1️⃣ הכנה: שטפו ידיים היטב 🧼 2️⃣ הבדיקה: הכניסו בעדינות שתי אצבעות מתחת ללשון של התינוק ונסו להרים אותה מעט כלפי מעלה 👆 3️⃣ מה מחפשים? 🔍 אנחנו רוצים לראות שהלשון עולה בחופשיות. אם אתם מרגישים התנגדות, או רואים שהקצה של הלשון נמשך פנימה לצורת “לב” ❤️ – ייתכן שהלשון קשורה. אמהות מניקות? Databile al VI secolo a.C., l’aulos di Selinunte appartiene alla cosiddetta “early type”, una tipologia simile a strumenti rinvenuti in Grecia e nelle colonie occidentali. Era lo strumento dei riti sacri, delle danze rituali, dei cori che onoravano le divinità. Potrebbe aver accompagnato le celebrazioni dedicate a Demetra, divinità legata ai cicli della natura e della fertilità. Il ritrovamento è avvenuto nel contesto degli scavi condotti dalla New York University, sotto la direzione di Clemente Marconi, e rappresenta una rara testimonianza della musica nel mondo greco-arcaico. Ma la vera rivoluzione è avvenuta grazie alla ricerca: con il progetto Telestes – Marie Curie Actions, la musicologa Angela Bellia ha ricostruito digitalmente l’aulos con stampa 3D, offrendo agli studiosi la possibilità di analizzarne la struttura e persino di provare a riprodurne il suono. Un’esperienza unica di archeologia musicale, che unisce scienza e suggestione, riportando in vita le note perdute dell’antichità. Dove vederlo? L’aulos di Selinunte è oggi esposto presso il Baglio Florio, all’interno del Parco Archeologico di Selinunte, dove i visitatori possono ammirarlo da vicino e immergersi nel suo incredibile viaggio lungo 2.600 anni. #selinunte #aulos #sicelioti #anticagrecia #archeologiasiciliana 𝓼𝓲𝓬𝓲𝓵𝓲𝓪𝓷 472 · 9-13 Calanchi del Canniz

L’aulos di Selinunte è oggi esposto presso il Baglio Florio, all’interno del Parco Archeologico di Selinunte, dove i visitatori possono ammirarlo da vicino e immergersi nel suo incredibile viaggio lungo 2.600 anni. #selinunte #aulos #sicelioti #anticagrecia #archeologiasiciliana 𝓼𝓲𝓬𝓲𝓵𝓲𝓪𝓷 472

@מטי עובדיה #החייםשלקוקו Ella Ovadia 12.4K · 9-16 באלי פנטה igalhaim_ 44.8K · 9-23 #עלמאולמה עלמא 13.1K · 9-7 הבדיקה שכל הורה חייב להכיר עוד בבית החולים 🏥👶🏻 חשוב שתדעו – לשון קשורה היא ממש לא “רק בעיה של הנקה” ❗ מדובר בעניין תפקודי שיכול להשפיע על הבייבי שלכם בהרבה תחומים אחרים: • קשיים בהאכלה 🍼: קושי בתפיסה של מוצץ או בקבוק (לא רק שד). • התפתחות הדיבור 🗣️: קושי בהגיית צלילים מסוימים בגילאים מאוחרים יותר. • בריאות כללית 🧠: השפעה על נשימת פה, מבנה הלסת והשיניים, ואפילו ריור מוגבר. אז מה זה בעצם “לשון תפקודית”? 🤔 השאלה היא לא רק איך הלשון נראית, אלא איך היא עובדת. כפי שניתן לראות בתמונה 📸, כשהלשון קשורה היא לא מצליחה להתרומם ולהיצמד לחיך. התוצאה היא “תפיסה שטחית” שגורמת לתינוק להתעייף מהר 😴, לבלוע אוויר 🌬️ ולפעמים גם לסבול מגזים או מחוסר שקט 😣. איך תבדקו את זה כבר בבית החולים? 🏨 אל תחכו שמשהו ישתבש, פשוט תבדקו 👇 1️⃣ הכנה: שטפו ידיים היטב 🧼 2️⃣ הבדיקה: הכניסו בעדינות שתי אצבעות מתחת ללשון של התינוק ונסו להרים אותה מעט כלפי מעלה 👆 3️⃣ מה מחפשים? 🔍 אנחנו רוצים לראות שהלשון עולה בחופשיות. אם אתם מרגישים התנגדות, או רואים שהקצה של הלשון נמשך פנימה לצורת “לב” ❤️ – ייתכן שהלשון קשורה. אמהות מניקות? 🤱 שימו לב אם יש לכן פצעים או כאבים חזקים בזמן ההנקה 😖 – זה סימן אזהרה קלאסי לכך שהלשון לא מבצעת את פעולת ה”גריפה” בצורה נכונה. אבחון מוקדם יכול למנוע הרבה תסכול בהמשך הדרך 🙏 מוזמנות לשואל כל ש⁩אלה על לשון קשורה⬇️ #לשוןקשורה#ייעוץהנקה Xenia_babysleep 2513 · 4d ago Cappuccino.palestine 348 · 4d ago יוצרת התוכן ליר כהן הופתעה על ידי בן הזוג בחופשה בלימסול - אבל ממש לא בטיסה רגילה. השניים המריאו לקפריסין במטוס פרטי יוקרתי ובכרטיס בשווי של כ-61 אלף שקלים. Surrounded by lush nature and green forests, this temple is most famous for its hundreds of Buddha Statues inside its massive hall. But for me the true highlight are the sweeping views over the surrounding countryside from the nearby pagoda. And the best feature: I was the only person there 😍🚋 To get to Echizen Daibutsu, take the Echizen train line from Fukui to the final stop, Katsuyama and then get on a bus to the bus stop called NTT Katsuyama-mae. Surrounded by lush nature and green forests, this temple is most famous for its hundreds of Buddha Statues inside its massive hall. But for me the true highlight are the sweeping views over the surrounding countryside from the nearby pagoda. And the best feature: I was the only person there 😍🚋 To get to Echizen Daibutsu, take the Echizen train line from Fukui to the final stop, Katsuyama and then get on a bus to the bus stop called NTT Katsuyama-mae. fullText: TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok huanletravel · 6-1 For a first trip to Thailand, do not only check where to take photos. Sort out entry rules, hotels, transport, sights and common mistakes before departure, and the whole trip becomes much easier.This guide groups Thailand into Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Pattaya and Phuket, with top sights, food, where to stay, transport tips, useful apps and TDAC arrival-card reminders.Before You Go Keep your passport valid for more than 6 months. Save return tickets and hotel bookings on your phone, and prepare some cash just in case.Where to Stay First-timers in Bangkok can stay near Siam or CentralWorld. In Phuket, choose around Patong, Kata or Karon. Pattaya is convenient near Beach Road or Second Road. In Chiang Mai, Nimman is practical, while the Old City feels more local.Transport Tips Use BTS/MRT in Bangkok when possible. Phuket and Chiang Mai sights are spread out, so taxis or private cars are easier. Tuk-tuks are fun, but agree on the price first.Small Reminders Do not bring durian into hotel rooms. Do not casually enter shops with green leaf signs. Airport exchange rates are usually poor. 👇🗓️ DAY 1: ROYAL VIBESLondon Eye: Don’t just stand still; walk around the capsule for 360° views. 🎡Big Ben: Cross the bridge to the ‘St Thomas’ Hospital’ side for the best photo angle. 📸Westminster Abbey: Look for the ‘Oldest Door’ in Britain (it’s 900+ years old!). 🚪Buckingham Palace: Get your ticket stamped at the end to turn it into a 1-year pass! 👑Horse Guards: Visit at 4:00 PM for the ‘Dismounting Ceremony’—it’s less crowded! 🐴National Gallery: Head to Room 43 to see Van Gogh’s famous Sunflowers for free. 🌻Leicester Sq: Check the TKTS booth for half-price same-day theater tickets. 🎭Shaftesbury Fountain: It’s actually a statue of Anteros, not Eros! 💘Carnaby St: Look up—the overhead decorations change every few months. 🛍️Oxford St: Escape the crowds at ‘Selfridges’ rooftop bar for a break. 🥂🗓️ DAY 2: SKYLINES & HISTORYTate Modern: Go to the 10th-floor viewing terrace in the Blavatnik Building for a free skyline view. 🖼️Borough Market: Look for the ‘Strawberry Chocolate’ cups—they are the 2026 viral snack. 🍓The Shard: If you don’t want to pay for the view, book a drink at ‘Aqua Shard’ instead. 🍸Tower Bridge: Check the bridge lift times online so you can see it open! 🌉Tower of London: See the Crown Jewels FIRST thing to avoid the 2-hour queue. 💎St. Dunstan in the East: The best place for a quiet sandwich away from the city noise. 🌿Sky Garden: Tickets drop every Monday morning—set an alarm or you’ll miss out! 🌵Leadenhall Market: Find the blue shopfront at 42 Bull’s Head Passage (Diagon Alley entrance!). 🧙‍♂️St. Paul’s: Climb to the ‘Golden Gallery’ for the highest outdoor view in the City. ⛪🗓️ DAY 3: COLOR & CULTUREBritish Museum: The Rosetta Stone is usually surrounded; see the Parthenon Marbles for more space. 🏛️Neal’s Yard: Go before 10 AM to get photos without the brunch crowds. 🌈Chinatown: Grab a ‘Fish-shaped Taiyaki’ from Bake for the perfect snack. 🍦Covent Garden: Head to the lower level of the Apple Market to hear opera singers for free. 🎶Somerset House: In summer, run through the 55 fountains in the courtyard! ⛲ 💡 PRO TIP: London is a "Tap & Pay" city. 🤔 השאלה היא לא רק איך הלשון נראית, אלא איך היא עובדת. כפי שניתן לראות בתמונה 📸, כשהלשון קשורה היא לא מצליחה להתרומם ולהיצמד לחיך. התוצאה היא “תפיסה שטחית” שגורמת לתינוק להתעייף מהר 😴, לבלוע אוויר 🌬️ ולפעמים גם לסבול מגזים או מחוסר שקט 😣. איך תבדקו את זה כבר בבית החולים? 🏨 אל תחכו שמשהו ישתבש, פשוט תבדקו 👇 1️⃣ הכנה: שטפו ידיים היטב 🧼 2️⃣ הבדיקה: הכניסו בעדינות שתי אצבעות מתחת ללשון של התינוק ונסו להרים אותה מעט כלפי מעלה 👆 3️⃣ מה מחפשים? 🔍 אנחנו רוצים לראות שהלשון עולה בחופשיות. אם אתם מרגישים התנגדות, או רואים שהקצה של הלשון נמשך פנימה לצורת “לב” ❤️ – ייתכן שהלשון קשורה. אמהות מניקות? 🤱 שימו לב אם יש לכן פצעים או כאבים חזקים בזמן ההנקה 😖 – זה סימן אזהרה קלאסי לכך שהלשון לא מבצעת את פעולת ה”גריפה” בצורה נכונה. אבחון מוקדם יכול למנוע הרבה תסכול בהמשך הדרך 🙏 מוזמנות לשואל כל ש⁩אלה על לשון קשורה⬇️ #לשוןקשורה#ייעוץהנקה Xenia_babysleep 2585 · 4d ago #פוריו #בשבילך #ימין #שמאל #פוליטיקה Hadar Muchtar 1778 · 4d ago #rahmaghorbel رَحْمَة 145.4K · 9-23 באלי פנטה igalhaim_ 45K · 9-23 פסטיבל התמר אתם חלוםםםםםםם שרית חדד 14.8K · 2d ago #fyp #جامعة #foryou Mohammed 151.3K · 9-24 למה או או כשאפשר גם וגם? caption: If you’re planning a trip to Japan, there are a few mistakes that many tourists make without realizing it. These mistakes can make your trip
music: Japanese style impression of koto and piano 1256571
fullText: TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok Kylie · 3-6 If you’re planning a trip to Japan, there are a few mistakes that many tourists make without realizing it. These mistakes can make your trip more expensive, more stressful, and sometimes less authentic. The good news is that most of them are very easy to avoid once you know what to do instead.The first mistake happens when booking flights. Many travelers automatically choose direct flights because they want to save time. However, direct flights can easily cost more than $1,200 round trip. If you accept a short layover in places like China or Korea, you can often find flights between $500 and $600. The travel time difference is small, but the money you save can be huge.Another common mistake is landing at Narita Airport. While tickets to Narita sometimes look cheaper, the airport is actually far from Tokyo. After landing, you still need to take a train that can take around 90 minutes and cost around $15 to $20 just to reach the city. Haneda Airport is a much better option because it is only about 25 minutes from central Tokyo and much easier to access.Food is another area where many tourists fall into traps. Popular chains like Kura Sushi or trendy Instagram cafés are often designed for tourists. While they can be fun to try once, they do not represent the real Japanese food culture. Some of the best meals in Japan are found in small neighborhood izakaya where locals eat. These places are usually cheaper and offer a much more authentic experience.Accommodation can also be a problem for travelers who only look at tourist districts. Hotels in areas like Shibuya or Shinjuku can easily cost $100 per night for extremely small rooms. Renting an apartment in neighborhoods like Ikebukuro, Nippori, or Kinshicho can give you much more space while also being cheaper.Transportation is another misunderstood topic. Many travelers buy the JR Pass automatically because it used to be a great deal. However, after recent price increases, it is not always worth it anymore. For many trips between cities like Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka, simply using a Suica card can be cheaper and much easier.Finally, timing your trip is very important. Cherry blossom season is beautiful but also extremely crowded and expensive. Visiting Japan in months like November or February can offer a much more peaceful experience with lower prices and fewer tourists.Avoiding these mistakes will make your trip smoother, cheaper, and far more enjoyable. #japantravel #japantips #traveljapan #japantrip #esimjapan more 678.2K 3002 398.2K 98.4K Dr.Talat Alsana · 3d ago #onthisday 00:00 / 00:00 217 0 8 8 Comments You may like #onthisday Dr.Talat Alsana 217 · 3d ago נהג חדש יצא ל״נסיעת מבחן״ ב-145 קמ״ש — וה7ג אם ותינוקת נהג חדש קנה רכב וכמה ימים אחר כך יצא ל״נסיעת מבחן״. במקום שבו המהירות המותרת היא 90 קמ״ש הוא האיץ ל-140–145 קמ״ש, איבד שליטה ונכנס במלוא העוצמ

fullText: TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok Kylie · 4-13 Everyone thinks Japan is expensive. In 2026, it's one of the cheapest developed countries in the world. Here is exactly how I did 10 days in Japan for €1,200 all-in.First, the flight. I never fly direct to Japan. Paris-Tokyo direct is €1,200 minimum. With a layover in Istanbul, Doha or Seoul, it drops to €500. Three extra hours in the air, €700 back in your pocket. That is 5 nights of accommodation or 2 weeks of food in Japan.Second, accommodation. Japanese hotels are now €150 per night for 15m² boxes where the bed takes the whole room. I book apartments on Rakuten Travel or Japanican for €70 to €80 per night: 40m², kitchen, laundry machine. Twice the space, half the price. Never Airbnb in Japan, the regulation killed it.Third, transport. The JR Pass is dead. Price went up 70% in 2023, €330 for 7 days, and you need to cross Japan multiple times to break even. Just use a Suica card and pay per trip. Saves me €100-150 every single trip.Fourth, food. I eat for €15 a day in Japan and I eat well. Konbini breakfast for €3, ramen lunch for €6, izakaya dinner for €12. Or supermarket half-price bentos after 7pm for €2.50. Japan is cheaper than Paris on food, not even close.And the one thing nobody prepares: internet. Without it you cannot book, translate, navigate or pay. And most generic eSIMs block your apps and your bank the moment you land. I always get PlanJapan before flying: €15 for 2 weeks, all apps work, zero issues. Link in my bio.Full 10-day breakdown: flight €500, apartment €400, food €150, transport €50, activities €100. Total €1,200. caption: "Hanoi Hannah" was the moniker given to Trịnh Thị Ngọ, a Vietnamese broadcaster known for her propaganda broadcasts directed at U.S. troops during the Vietnam War. The right one quietly makes everything easier.Swipe through to find the area that fits how you travel.Save this before you book 🗺️ #parís #paristravel #paristips #parisguide #parisarrondissements more 224.6K 1238 157K 19.8K Sara View Travel ✈️ · 6d ago I spent more than one day in Antibes, so don’t let this vlog make you think I did all of this in a single afternoon. These are simply the parts I loved most and would personally repeat if I were planning one really good summer day here.My Antibes non-negotiables:- Start in Juan-les-Pins for the beach. If sand and swimming matter to you, this is the part I’d prioritize.- Le Ruban Bleu was my favorite overall beach club choice. Beautiful setting, sandy beach, clear water, and we also had a really good lunch there.- My other favorite was La Plage des Îles, so I’d keep both on your shortlist depending on availability and the kind of setup you prefer.- Don’t leave Juan-les-Pins immediately after the beach. Walk around a little. There are small boutiques, shops, cafés and plenty of places for a crêpe.- Give yourself time for Old Antibes too. Wander without overplanning it. The little streets, restaurants and shops are part of what makes it so nice.- Walk the Antibes ramparts along the sea. You’ll get beautiful coastal views and pass sandy beaches like Plage de la Gravette below the Old Town.- Continue toward Le Nomade, the huge openwork sculpture made from letters. Stop for a coffee or a drink, then keep going toward Port Vauban and the yachts.- And if the Ferris wheel is running, go up. The view over Antibes from the top was such a good ending.What I liked most about Antibes is that you don’t have to choose between a beach day and seeing the town. You can do both without the day feeling rushed.Save this for your French Riviera trip. And tell me: what are your non-negotiables?If you missed my Nice, Menton, Monaco or Villefranche-sur-Mer videos, they’re already on my profile. Cannes and Saint-Tropez are next. Footage of the dramatic incident, which took place last Thursday, shows the furious woman gripping the teen girl by the hair in front of a crowd of onlookers in the world-famous Italian city. The mom of eight was able to track down her stolen purse by using the “Find My Friends” feature on her AirPods, which were inside it, according to her daughter, Karis McElroy, who shared the original video of the confrontation on TikTok. Karis’ mom was on vacation in Venice with her stepdad when they were crowded by a group of girls on a narrow bridge, and soon realized that her backpack had been unzipped and her purse containing her credit cards, cash and passport was missing, along with a metal water bottle. “Her and my stepdad immediately started tracking her purse through her AirPods on Find My Friends, and they were able to track it down back to those three girls,” Karis said in a subsequent video. “So she goes and chases them down, and she grabs one of the girls by her ponytail and does not let go. Two of the girls stay, one of the girls runs away with my mom’s purse,” she went on. “She said she didn’t care about any of the other stuff in the bag, but she just at least wanted her passport so she could get home,” she said. “The police officers came, and they were about to arrest these girls when the girl that had the bag over her shoulder went and swung it and hit my mom, and it hit my mom in the head,” Karis said. “And in the bag was that metal water bottle that they took from my mom. So my mom had a massive gash on her head, and it was bleeding everywhere. She got a black eye from it, and the girls were arrested. And then my mom had to go to the hospital and get some stitches.” The third girl got a train to the airport where she was stopped and Karis’ mom’s passport recovered, along with her credit cards, although she didn’t get the cash and AirPods back, Karis said. 📸: TikTok / karismcelroy more 144.6K 1567 4019 1828 Comments You may like Log in

Before leaving for the Trojan War, Ulysses had raised Argos as a strong hunting dog. However, Ulysses was away from home for twenty years—ten years at war and another ten years on his journey back. During his long absence, Argos was neglected and left to grow old without proper care.When Ulysses finally returned to Ithaca, he disguised himself as an old beggar to avoid being recognized by the suitors who had taken over his palace. Although no one else recognized him, Argos immediately knew his master by his voice, scent, and appearance. The old dog could only wag his tail and lower his ears because he was too weak to stand up and greet Ulysses.The reunion between Ulysses and Argos is one of the most touching moments in The Odyssey. Ulysses, unable to reveal his identity, silently shed a tear before walking on. After seeing his beloved master one last time, Argos peacefully died. 🤔 השאלה היא לא רק איך הלשון נראית, אלא איך היא עובדת. כפי שניתן לראות בתמונה 📸, כשהלשון קשורה היא לא מצליחה להתרומם ולהיצמד לחיך. התוצאה היא “תפיסה שטחית” שגורמת לתינוק להתעייף מהר 😴, לבלוע אוויר 🌬️ ולפעמים גם לסבול מגזים או מחוסר שקט 😣. איך תבדקו את זה כבר בבית החולים? 🤱 שימו לב אם יש לכן פצעים או כאבים חזקים בזמן ההנקה 😖 – זה סימן אזהרה קלאסי לכך שהלשון לא מבצעת את פעולת ה”גריפה” בצורה נכונה. אבחון מוקדם יכול למנוע הרבה תסכול בהמשך הדרך 🙏 מוזמנות לשואל כל ש⁩אלה על לשון קשורה⬇️ #לשוןקשורה#ייעוץהנקה Xenia_babysleep 2984 · 6d ago הפתעההההההה ✈️ Omrilevi9 66.9K · 9-14 Log in

ADAPT QUICKLY If I were new in the UAE today, the first thing I would do is accept that life won’t be perfect from day one and the environment isn’t the same as where I came from. Instead of complaining about every challenge, I would focus on adapting as quickly as possible. Different country, different culture, different way of doing things. For example, as someone with food neophobia, I would explore new cuisines to save money instead of eating the pricey foods I’m used to. One thing I’ve learned is that the sooner you stop resisting change, the sooner you start growing. 2. INVEST IN MYSELF Investing in yourself doesn’t simply mean eating what you always crave or buying the best clothes. I understand some people want to live the YOLO life, but not everyone is the same so I understand this might not be for everyone. But one thing I would do differently is make myself the first investment. I’d invest in learning new skills, improving my qualifications, and building multiple income opportunities, if possible, before putting money into big investments back home. And here is the part where most people get me wrong: investing back home is a good thing, but you need to understand that some projects and investments may take time to pay off, and with a small salary, it will take even longer. The better you become, the more money you’ll have to invest later. A strong foundation makes everything else easier. 3

TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok Notes from Maria 🌸 · 4-17 We visited Malta in 2021 for a week and honestly, we loved it there. We currently live in Italy. We love it here, but we're thinking about starting our own business and Italy is not the easiest place for that. Malta keeps coming up as the answer we didn't expect.Here are a few things I’ve found out and are not in the slides:🏠 RentingA one-bedroom apartment in areas like Sliema or St. Julian's runs €800-1200/month. Most rentals come furnished, which saves a lot when you're relocating.🚌 Transport reality checkBuses work but they're not always on time and they get packed during rush hour. Bolt and eCabs are reliable for shorter trips. The island is so small that "far away" means 40 minutes. 📶 For remote workersInternet speeds rank 12th in Europe. There are coworking spaces like Soho and The Hub, plus over 400 free Wi-Fi hotspots across the island. One in five residents is a foreigner, so the expat and entrepreneur community is already huge.⚠️ Things no one tells youMalta is one of the most densely populated countries in the EU. The island is small, if you need wide open green spaces, it might feel tight. But if you're a sea person, you'll never feel limited.We’re still thinking about it, but for now it looks like the best place in Europe, specially if you’re a freelancer or want to start a business! TikTok Search For You Explore Following Short dramas LIVE Upload Profile More Log in Company Program Terms & Policies More © 2026 TikTok Kylie · 4-3 Japan is incredible — but not every spot lives up to the hype. After multiple trips, here are the places I'd skip and what I'd do instead.Arashiyama Bamboo Grove looks magical on Instagram. In reality, it's a 200-meter path packed with thousands of tourists. You won't get a single clean photo unless you show up at 5am. Most people leave disappointed.Osaka Castle is beautiful from the outside — and it's free to enjoy the park. But the inside is a reconstructed concrete museum with elevators and modern glass displays. Save your ¥600 and admire it from the gardens instead.Robot Restaurant in Shinjuku is still showing up in travel blogs, but it's either permanently closed or turned into a forgettable show. The TikTok videos are years old. Don't plan your evening around it.TeamLab Planets is visually stunning but costs ¥3,500 and you'll queue at every single room. The crowds destroy the experience. If you want the same vibe without the chaos, try TeamLab Botanical Garden in Osaka — it's outdoor and way quieter.One thing that almost ruined my trip: my eSIM. Popular brands like Airalo or Holafly route through foreign servers, so TikTok and banking apps stop working in Japan. I switched to a Japan-only eSIM on a local network — problem solved. Check PlanJapon if you want one that actually works.Maid cafés sound fun but most Western tourists leave feeling awkward. If you're into anime culture, hit the arcades in Akihabara or themed izakayas instead.The real rule? 2-3 activities a day, max. Here is what I sawAs you approach the cliffs edge, it’s nothing but open water, until your feet step over the edge. It feels like a leap of faith, but just before you fall, the first step catches you and the chapel reveals itselfThe chapel sits within a narrow cleft in limestone cliffs, built in the 13th century. I can’t put into words what it feels like to see this doorway - it almost beckons you into another realmIt has been a site of pilgrimage for centuries. Standing in this small room, I felt connected to all those who made the descent before me, our stories etched into its wallsI wondered about the reasons they came. Did they seek out healing for themselves or loved ones? Legends tell of a well inside the chapel, said to heal diseaseOr perhaps they came to pray at St Govan’s altar, where it is said his remains layThe small opening in the chapel frames the waves below, a view that’s likely barely changed over the centuries. What went through the minds of those before me looking at this view?The stories say that St Govan was being chased by pirates when a cleft in the rock opened up, closing behind him until the pirates leftThe location of the construction is remarkable. Metres down a cliff face and likely without the ease of a staircase. I began to think about the builders, what made them choose this place?Hi, I’m Jacklynn and I travel in the pursuit of history. I feel deeply connected to those who’ve come before us and spend too much time wondering about their lives.
